en|NeuroSuite nasce per collegare segnal:
NeuroSuite was created to connect signals that today remain separate: environments, events,
 daily habits, operational priorities and existing devices when useful.
 The first concrete application concerns residential care facilities, assisted-living apartmentsand support for vulnerable people.
en|Nei contesti di cura gli eventi sono:
In healthcare contexts there are many events. An orderly reading is needed,
 continuous and shareable of what happens over time.
en|NeuroSuite collega segnali ambientali: NeuroSuite connects environmental signals, habits, operational demands and context variations into a simple, verifiable and supervised readout.
en|NeuroSuite opera come sistema di supp: NeuroSuite operates as observational support; any clinical evaluation remains with authorized professionals. Decisions remain in the hands of the responsible people.
en|L’obiettivo è affiancare operatori e: The objective is to support operators and caregivers in their daily work, making signals, changes and priorities that deserve attention more visible.

en|L’Europa sta entrando nella più grand: Europe is entering the greatest demographic transformation in its history. There were approximately 30.8 million people requiring ongoing assistance and the projection exceeds 38 million by 2050.
en|La domanda cresce, il tempo operativo: Demand grows, operational time becomes more precious and the ability to read distributed signals takes on strategic value.
en|NeuroSuite nasce per mettere ordine i: NeuroSuite was created to bring order to this complexity: it connects signals, context and priorities in a useful reading for those who follow the person every day.

en|Familiari, caregiver, badanti, operat: Family members, caregivers, home-care workers, workers and professionals observe many things, often with separate tools and time constraints.
en|NeuroSuite porta continuità osservati: NeuroSuite brings observational continuity where signals already exist, connects them and makes them easier to read over time.

en|Ogni segnale viene letto insieme agli: Each signal is read together with the others: place, moment, frequency, repetition, proximity and daily routines.
en|NeuroSuite evidenzia variazioni, rico: NeuroSuite highlights variations, occurrences and combinations that may merit human verification.
en|Le decisioni restano nelle mani delle: Decisions remain in the hands of the responsible people. NeuroSuite brings to the attention of those who work what deserves to be seen.

en|Da due stanze a una baseline struttur: From two rooms to a structured baseline.
en|Il trial parte con un assetto prudent: The trial starts with a prudent and operational structure: inclusion criteria, informed consent, choice of available people, signals to observe, privacy rules, access to data and reports.
en|La sequenza crea una base osservativa: The sequence creates a readable observation base: starting on 2 rooms, extending to 4 rooms, individual baseline, reading the deviations from the individual baselineand preparing for scaling.
en|Criteri, consenso, tecnologia minima,: Criteria, consent, minimum technology, signals, privacy and reporting.
en|Avvio su 2 stanze per accettabilità,: Boot on 2 rooms for acceptability, usability, technical stability and basic signals.
en|Estensione a 4 stanze con casi differ: Extension to 4 rooms with different cases and individual baselines compared to the person's history.

en|La baseline integra segnali ambiental: The baseline integrates environmental and neurofunctional signals.
en|MUSE entra come approfondimento autor: MUSE enters as an authorized study.
en|Nella fase di baseline, sensori ambie: In the baseline phase, environmental sensors, routines, movement, sleep, language and interactions build the observational history of the individual person.
en|MUSE o sistemi EEG portatili equivale: MUSE or equivalent portable EEG systems can add observational neurofunctional signals, when the clinical-operational path and authorizations require it.
en|Dopo due o tre settimane di osservazi: After two or three weeks of observation, weekly or fortnightly measurements help to read any deviations from the individual baselinecompared to the individual baseline.
en|Per verificare subito la catena tecni: To immediately verify the technical chain, NeuroSuite can use simulated variations of the trace as controlled input: the system receives a signal consistent with a real detection, produces operational attention and prepares sending to caregivers, doctors and authorised professionals.
An already active line of research.
en|NeuroSuite si colloca in una linea sc: NeuroSuite is part of a scientific line that studies neurophysiological, linguistic, motor and digital signals. The system uses them as observational and contextual elements within a supervised path.
en|MUSE viene studiato come sistema EEG: MUSE is designed as a portable EEG system for ERP research, useful as a methodological reference for light and authorized signals.
en|La letteratura su resting-state EEG s: The literature on resting-state EEG supports the interest in observational rhythms linked to progression and cognitive study.
en|Delta, Theta, Alpha e Beta sono bande: Delta, Theta, Alpha and Beta are useful bands to read over time along with context, routines and other signals.
en|Pattern EEG quantitativi sono studiat: Quantitative EEG patterns are also studied in Parkinson's disease as part of a neurofunctional readout.
en|Il parlato narrativo e le caratterist: Narrative speech and linguistic features are a source of digital biomarkers in the study of cognitive impairment.
en|Cammino e movimento hanno valore osse: Gait and movement have longitudinal observational value when they are read into the history of the person.
en|Il modello economico lavora sulla ric: The economic model works on the daily recurrence for person supported. The initial base is the Brescia Solidale Foundation; a second reserved foundation has advanced interest and a possible window consistent with digitalization, prevention, AI and improvement of services.

en|Il valore strategico nasce da dati ag: Strategic value arises from aggregated and anonymized data, consensus, traceability, quality, observational research, benchmarking and model improvement.
